Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 12. Risk treatment and acceptance

12.1 Treatmentoptions

| OPTION | DESCRIPTION | TYPICALAPPLICATIONANDCONSTRAINTS |
|---|---|---|
| Avoid | Cease,decline or do not commence the activity giving rise to the risk | AppliedwhereresidualriskisCriticalorfallsin a zero-appetitecategory |
| Reduce | Implement or strengthen controls to lower impact, likelihood orboth | The default option;requires a dated plan with a named owner |
| Transfer | Share thefinancial conseguence through insurance,indemnityorcontractual allocation | Transfersfinancialconseguenceonly.Regulatory andreputational accountability is never transferred |
| Accept | Toleratetheresidualriskwithoutfurthertreatment | Requiresformal,time-boundapproval attheauthority level inSection7.8 |

Outsourcingdoes noi transfer accountability. Where an activity is performed by a third party,theGroup remains accountable to its customers and regulators for the outcome.

## 12.2 Treatment plans

Every treatment plan must record the risk reference, the specific actions, a single named accountable owner at Director level or above, a target completion date, the expected residual rating on completion, interim mitigations, and the approving forum. Plans exceeding twelve months must be broken into individually tracked milestones.

12.3Riskacceptance

| RESIDUALRATING | APPROVALAUTHORITY | MAXIMUM DURATION | REVIEWREQUIREMENT |
|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | Board Risk Committee | 6 months | Monthlyreview;re-approval requiredto extend |
| High | Group Executive Risk Committee | 12 months | Quarterly review; re-approval reguired to extend |
| Elevated | Divisional Risk Committee | 12 months | Semi-annual review |
| Moderate and below | Risk owner | 24 months | Review at next RCSAcycle |

Acceptances expire automatically on their stated date. An expired acceptance is a policy breach and the underlying risk reverts to requiring treatment. Rolling re-approval of the same acceptance for a third consecutive term requires escalation one level above the normal authority, on the basis that persistent acceptance indicates an unresolved structural problem.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ACC-2026-018 | RSK-4488—residualaccess risk pending IAMuplift | High | NaomiK.Osadebe (EMP-41077) | M.T.Achebe | 11/12/2026 |
| ACC-2026-014 | RSK-4502—yendordata handlingpendingcontract renewal | High | DevanshR.Kulkarni (EMP-39220) | M.T.Achebe | 30/09/2026 |
| ACC-2026-011 | RSK-4519-sanctions screeningfalse-negativerate | Elevated | FumikoL.Nakagawa (EMP-38412) | DivisionalRC | 31/10/2026 |
| ACC-2026-006 | RSK-4560—recordsretention gap, Mumbai office | Elevated | Ananya V.Chatterjee (EMP-37903) | DivisionalRC | 15/08/2026 |
| ACC-2025-029 | RSK-4433—legacyplatform unsupported components | Critical | Lars-ErikBrannstrom (EMP-41402) | BoardRiskCttee | 31/07/2026 |

## 12.5Prohibitedtreatments

* Reducing a residual rating without a corresponding, evidenced change to controls.

•Re-scoring impactor likelihood to move a riskbelow an escalation threshold,absent a genuinechange in exposure.

•Splitting a single risk into smaller components sa that no component reaches a reporting threshold.

•Recording a treatment plan ascomplete before thecontrol is operating and has beentested.

•Accepting a risk in a zero-appetite category, which is not permitted at any level ofauthority.

## 12.6 Closure and verification

A treatment action may be closed only when the control is operating, evidence has been retained, and the second line has verified closure. For actions arising from internal audit findings, verification is performed by Group Internal Audit under Ifeoma C. Adeyemi. Selfclosure without independent verification is not permitted for risks rated High or above.
